title: The Money Tree of Life
subtitle: A Story About Four Friends and Their Financial Journey
description: Join Liam, Emma, Mateo, and Aisha as they discover a magical tree that teaches them how money works. Through adventures and lessons, learn how saving builds roots, budgeting grows branches, earning adds leaves, investing plants seeds, and giving shares the shade.
author: Cornelius A. Pratt (Mr. CAP)
